reason: The live installed-extension Background Exec measurement was NOT executed by the agent. The agent's run_commands substrate is itself a ClineMM Seatbelt-sandboxed Background Exec command, and nested sandbox-exec is denied there ('sandbox-exec: sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted', rc=71). A VSCodium extension host launched from that substrate cannot apply ANY Seatbelt profile, so the candidate rule would never reach the kernel. Additionally the VSCodium extensions directory (~/.vscodium-clinemm/extensions) is outside the agent's Seatbelt writable roots, so the diagnostic VSIX cannot be installed into the running dogfood instance. The diagnostic VSIX WAS built, installed into a writable extensions dir, and its bundle SHA-256 verified identical; only the GUI launch + measurement require the operator.
